name: IFs mFRR 9.9, aFRR 9.6&9.8 Changes to Bid Availability Archives

query.description: [M] EIC code of a Scheduling Area or LFA
[O] C40 = Conditional bid; C41 = Thermal limit; C42 = Frequency limit; C43 = Voltage limit; C44 = Current limit; C45 = Short-circuit current limits; C46 = Dynamic stability limit
[O] Integer: Zero‑based index of the first archive to return. The offset parameter paginates the response in batches of 100 archives (e.g., offset = n returns the archives in the range n+1 to n+100).
